what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6486 Somali refugees in Italy, 0.7% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1982 to 2025, at war level in most of the years since 2006, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 34 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 15641, at the end of 2017.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 1997, 2010 to 2019 and 2021 to 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
